ideas.title: Investigation into Minnesota Fraud Allegations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of widespread fraud in Minnesota and the potential involvement of high-ranking officials.
ideas.angle: The specific investigative angle would be to follow the money and determine the extent of the allegations.
questions: What is the extent of the allegations?
ideas.insight: I believe this story has a high potential for uncovering wrongdoing and corruption in Minnesota. The allegations are serious and the potential involvement of high-ranking officials makes it a priority investigation.
